text:
maria: Heads-up 1 I'm doing a focused refresh of the Hello quickstart: align snippets to SDK v8, rename env var, tighten Docker example, and fix a broken internal link. Planning to open one PR with smaller commits.
jon: Sounds good. Which env var name are we standardizing on?
maria: Switching from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. Also encouraging usage through the client constructor: `RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })`. I'll add a migration snippet and sed one-liner.
rachel: Can you drop the new JS and Python snippets here so I can run them in the snippets runner?
maria: JS:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const r = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello from Redwood!' });
console.log(r.output[0].content);
```
PY:```py
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_TOKEN'))
resp = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello from Redwood!')
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
sam: I'll run these in the CI container and report back. Reminder: snippet-runner on mac CI tends to flake so I'll use the linux container locally.
maria: thanks. Also: linkchecker flagged `/docs/quickstart/auth` as a 404; we now use `/docs/quickstart/credentials`. I'll update references and add a docs redirect entry.
lee: About the Dockerfile: please keep it single minimal multistage and avoid installing dev/test deps in the runtime image. New users bang on docker first and we had complaints about size.
maria: Yep — I'll include a minimal multistage example and a one-line note about not storing tokens in images.
 doc-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 1768590030.
jon: Quick ask: add a tiny paragraph "where to find your token" pointing to Console -> API keys. New users keep emailing support about that.
maria: Good call. I'll add the paragraph and a screenshot placeholder.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 1 warning (non-deterministic sample output), 0 errors.
sam: Ran container smoke: found an old env var in ./README.md and a trailing comma in the py example that hits py3.7. I made a small branch to fix both and will open a PR against your branch if that's OK.
maria: Please do. I'll consolidate branches and open the main PR after. CI checklist: docs build, snippet-runner, linkchecker green before merging.
jon: I can review wording and the migration blurb once PR is up. Ping @jon here.
rachel: I'll check the sample outputs to ensure deterministic examples.
maria: PR will be up in ~20 minutes. Thanks all. Closing thread after merge. :tada:
